source: lab (real recording; background replaced by a synthetic colour gradient, 'Modified with Segment Anything 2 Demo' watermark bottom-right)
units: pixels (x right, y DOWN, origin top-left) and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.motion: static (background identical across frames: mean abs diff ~4/765 per pixel, no shift); person's feet fixed at the same pixels all clip
camera.perspective_cues: none usable: no floor, walls or horizon visible (background replaced). Toy moves roughly in a plane facing the camera, close to the person's right side; its apparent size stays ~constant (flight height 92-98 px).

objects.name: teddy
objects.description: small brown red-panda / bear plush toy (orange-brown fur, white face markings, striped tail), held in the person's hands and tossed upward twice
objects.visible_frames: 0-72 (always visible; partly hidden by hands except during flight)
objects.reference_point: visible centre = bbox centre (cx, cy); in flight frames also mask centroid (mask_cx, mask_cy)

size_px_in_flight.vertical_bbox_height: 92-98 (median ~95), toy upright head-up during both flights
size_px_in_flight.width_across_axis: 40-59 (tail sticking out sideways makes it vary; body alone ~40)

objects.size_px_held_frames: manual bbox ~ 45-60 wide x 85-95 tall (less reliable, partly behind hands)

objects.name: person
objects.description: woman (face blurred), grey short-sleeve T-shirt, black baggy trousers, white sneakers with black stripes; stands in place facing right-front; tosses and catches the toy with both hands
objects.moves: stands still (feet, legs, torso, head fixed); only arms/hands move

static_extents_px.standing_height_note: top of hair to shoe sole, head tilted slightly up; 508-510 over the clip
static_extents_px.hand_right_extent_x: ~415-433 while holding low; up to 487-491 with arms out during the tosses

static_scene: no physical static objects: background is a synthetic smooth colour gradient (blue left, yellow/green centre, red/pink right), not a real surface

events.event: toy held at waist level, nearly still

events.note: touching hand at 15, clearly free at 17; uncertainty +-1 frame

events.event: toss 1: catch (first contact with right hand)
events.note: toy lowered by hands to waist by ~frame 30
toy bottom touching hand at 51, small gap at 52; +-1 frame
toy bottom meets right hand; lowered to waist by ~frame 64

events.event: toy held at waist until end

files.tracks/person.csv: per-frame person mask bbox (x0 contaminated by background artefacts; use upper_x0 / static extents)
files.bg.png: reconstructed static background used for segmentation
